items.title: A fresh look for Bitbucket Pipelines
items.summary: We’re refreshing the Bitbucket Pipelines experience to make it easier to read logs, find the steps you need, and navigate a pipeline run. The update focuses on the Pipelines list and Pipeline result pages. This is a visual refresh only. Your pipeline configurations, builds, data, runners, variables, deployments, and integrations stay as they are.
